description: This file defines the MetadataColumn interface used in Apache Spark to represent metadata columns in data sources, including methods and constants related to metadata preservation flags, column properties, and transformation.

classes.name: MetadataColumn
classes.description: Interface for a metadata column in Spark, providing methods to access column properties, transformation logic, and JSON metadata representation.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata column.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the metadata column values.

methods.name: isNullable
methods.description: Indicates whether the column values may be null (default true).

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Provides documentation for the column, or null if none.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Returns the Transform used to produce this metadata column, or null if none.

methods.name: metadataInJSON
methods.description: Returns the column metadata in JSON format.
